_doc: One entry per clip. gen: Kimodo prompt/frames/seed -> External Anims/Kimodo/<glb>.glb. retarget: mode + args for tools/glb_retarget.py. unity: import flags for tools/unity/verify_clip.py. 30 fps everywhere. Modes: idle = legs pinned IK, loop; loco = FK legs + root travel, gait loop; action = FK legs, in place, one-shot; death = FK legs, grounded lying, one-shot. layer: 'upper' = can be played on the UpperBody Animator layer over locomotion (attack on the move); 'full' = whole-body one-shot that stops the legs. Idles/loco/deaths carry no layer key. lift: whole-clip Root lift in engine metres passed to export_fbx --lift (default CLIP_LIFT 0.015); raise it when ground_clip.py reports a model under the floor.

clips.name: Attack_R_Stab
clips.heading: auto
clips._note: the user's reference P:\c7uJKSavZ5aC-mUqvTCBRmSJH.glb (2026-09-23; the mannequin app's skinless GLB, A-pose rest, 221 frames at 30 fps) -> attack_ref5_mocap.glb -> tools/glb_nodes_to_armature.py -> attack_ref5_arm.blend; stab: source frames 18-80; this take attacks with the RIGHT arm, so the R clip is the raw transfer and the L clip is mirrored; plain rotation transfer, no arm passes; time_scale 0.7692; no baked blends (the Animator transitions); widened (user: 'I need more frames, as transitions from/to blend the start/final frames'); mode action + plant_feet + drift root (user: 'the references include steps, like a step forward during the stab; apply them only if the bottom half is not busy'): the legs come from the capture with the feet planted, the take's net travel (stab 15 cm, slice 33 cm) goes on Root as root motion, and the arm-layer masks drop the legs whenever locomotion owns them; then (user): hand_tilt -45 (the blade pitched 45 deg up at the thrust; -30 left it 16 deg above the forearm, which itself thrusts 22 deg upward, so -45 lays it along the arm: 'tilt the hand so that sword is more forward pointing'), time_scale 0.3846 ('2 times faster'), unwind_yaw ('at the end of the attack the model's forward direction changes 5-10 deg': the take's net hips yaw is removed linearly); blade_along_arm (2026-09-23, 'sword still points in wrong direction', top view: hand_tilt fixed the pitch only, the hilt yaw was 75 deg left of the hips while the forearm thrust 18 deg right): the hand is rebuilt so the hilt continues the forearm line; lift 0.004 (2026-09-23, 'both feet slightly detach from the ground during attack': action mode grounds every frame against all six characters' boots, so the default 15 mm export lift floated both boots 17-24 mm on the Knight); ground_fit (2026-09-23, 'still slight lift is present'): per-frame Root lift measured in Unity so the highest of the six models' lowest vertex sits on the floor each frame (the others sink by the sole spread)

clips.name: Shoot_01
clips.prompt: (not Kimodo) video mocap 'bow attacks 2_default.glb' from the P: drive, *_JNT skeleton, 80 frames at 30 fps: the one shoot clip (user 2026-09-22: 'let's do only 1 shoot animation')
clips._note: user-recorded 2026-09-22, the single shoot clip (Shoot_02 retired the same day). The file holds the bow in the RIGHT hand, so --mirror (bow left, arrow right, as in Idle_Bow). still_joints LeftHand = the file's drawing hand (183 deg/s, 29 deg steps). blend_from/to Idle_Bow:1 raise and lower the bow arm from the idle; mode upper keeps the legs on IK; aim_forward L turns the body into the archer's stance with the rear foot stepping back and the string hand's fingers along the shot; stance as Idle_Bow; hips_drop 0.056 rig m (10 cm) faded with the crossfades: 'lower the torso a bit, standing too high makes leg twitch'; aim_body 0: the pelvis and feet keep the idle's heading, the turn to the shot line is a spine twist (user: 'body twists too much, so he is not shooting forward'); aim_line sight: the line from the head to the bow hand points forward, not the hand-to-hand line (both hands sat 0.2 rig m right of the head, the bow arm crossed the body 50 deg to the right: 'still shoots diagonally, rotate the left arm to the left more'); aim_offset 10 (the sight line 10 deg left, the bow arm then 7-9 deg right of forward: the two cannot both be 0, the head sits 16 cm right of the bow shoulder); anchor 1: the draw arm is swung in FK until the string hand lies on the sight plane (the arrow passes under the eye), the elbow swivelled level on the back/out side, the hand rolled 45 deg from the forearm's zero twist so the back of the hand faces out; anchor_gap 0.028 rig m (5 cm) keeps the string hand off the skull ('should not come so close to the head'); bow_square turns the bow hand until the bow's limbs are perpendicular to the arrow ('twist the left hand so that bow is perpendicular to the arrow'), squared for the whole raised phase against the sight line after 'straighten the bow a bit more'; anchor_gap 0.083 after 'don't bring the arrow too close to the head (10cm less)'; time_warp 22:11 + blend_in 10: the wind-up before the pull twice as fast ('faster wind-up 50%'); head_aim + head_smooth 3: the head looks along the sight line, smoothed ('less head jerk': the capture's head swung 65 deg in 20 frames and ended 47 deg off the target); pose_ref Fire_Base:1@37: the user's 'fire' pose (saved on frame 37 of the generated clip, copied to Fire_Base by anim_pose_save.py: bow hand, draw upper arm/forearm/hand) applied as local deltas while drawn, exact on frame 37
